ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution with approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the margins and central axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) are present along the entire trailing edge, with particularly jagged and large-scale tissue loss/notching on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible across the dark mid-sections of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular chipping and deep notches on the right lobe trailing edge indicating historical mechanical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast vertical white scar or pigmentation streak extending from the peduncle into the lower central ventral region.
